test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A train covers a distance of 57.6 km in 48 minutes. What is its speed in m/s?
solution:
Given:

A train covers a distance of 57.6 km in 48 minutes.

Concept used:

1m/s = 18/5 km/h

Time × Speed = Distance

Calculation:

48 minutes = 48 ÷ 60 = 0.8 hours

Hence, the speed of the train = 57.6 ÷ 0.8 = 72 km/h

Thus, the speed of the train = 72 ÷ (18/5) = 20 m/s

∴ Its speed is 20 m/s.
